scope_notes: No let/var declaration or angle-bracket reference-type compatibility parser remains; rejection fixtures are intentional.
Allocation and element selection return ordinary owner-aware views. Stored relative-reference types remain compiler-internal field layout information.
Val preserves independent bits, including intrinsic exception payloads. Ref/ptr preserve aliases; const ref permits a fixed statically known procedure alias.
Copies from result-producing scopes complete before local cleanup; ordinary escaping views still reject.
Nullable parameter/result modes and staged required-reference graph construction remain pending discussions (RO-Q3/RO-Q4).
No source-world mutation, regional encoding/toolchain configuration change, payload RTTI or user-runtime continuation mechanism is introduced.
